title: 安田記念の後に・故に、怪物

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I'll win! I will defeat Oguri!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Oguriiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan C
text_block_list.text: Go, Oguri! Wiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: GRAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (She's speeding up now?! How?!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I thought Oguri had already pushed herself to her limit…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But she sped up again in front of the stands!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: That was incredible, Ogurin! You're sooo coooool!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan C
text_block_list.text: That was classic Ogurin right at the end there! I can't wait for her next race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after the race ends, the audience continues crying out Oguri Cap's name. No matter how long we wait, the cheering keeps on going.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I thought I was good enough… I thought I could surpass Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But in the end, the audience was calling her name!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why? Why can't I catch up to her?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What is it that separates us? What am I lacking?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What do you think makes her so spectacular? What does she have that I don't?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How does she capture the hearts of everyone like this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Why does Oguri Cap get the support she does? Setting her background aside and just focusing on her running, I'd have to say…
choice_data_list: It's the second wind she gets just as she seems down for the count.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after expending all of her energy, Oguri Cap is able to speed up again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that there are moments in Oguri's running where it seems her spirit had been rekindled, so much so that it's impossible to look away.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're right… Oguri sped up again when we were in front of the stands.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, it was the same at the Mainichi Hai as well…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (This is it! All of my opponents have fallen behind me!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan
text_block_list.text: You got this, Oguriiiii! Keep going!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She made a comeback in front of the stands…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No doubt the audience feels like their cheers revive Oguri Cap just in time to take the win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In fact, that may very well be the case.
choice_data_list: I'm sure Oguri Cap herself also feels invigorated when she hears their cheers.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's right! She sped up right after they started cheering!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh… But that means…
choice_data_list: Oguri Cap gains strength from her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And they're all from your fans… I have to say I was surprised at the amount.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I guess they heard about my injury somehow.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Isn't that nice? I feel better already.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The support of my fans always gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri said the same thing once herself. She said she gets strength from her everyone cheering for her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Who would've thought it'd be literal strength…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If that's true, and if her popularity continues to grow at the rate it has been…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There's no limit to how strong she'll get!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Does that mean I have no chance of beating her?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I may have found an obsession, but the difference between us is staggering.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I just had some kind of edge…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri's fans are her weapon. If I had something like that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One thing comes immediately to mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I… AM…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: THE STRONGEEEST! THEEERE! IIIIIS! RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki tapped into a hidden font of power at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she can let her obsession drive her the way it did back then and run with her raw feelings exposed… she just might have a chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I believe Yaeno Muteki's true strength lies in her fiery competitive spirit. It's clear igniting that is the key to unlocking her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But like any fire, it can burn out of control if given too much fuel. That's why we've been using water still to control it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's been able to let that hungry fire within her breathe even more since she found her obsession, but if she could unleash it completely, all at once…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Letting her emotions run rampant, though, comes with the risk of losing control.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may not have realized it herself, but it looked as if Yaeno had an easy time today. I think we have the wide track at Tokyo Racecourse to thank for that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I believe she's always hyper-aware of the other runners around her, so she must have felt quite at ease on such a wide track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's always taking great care not to run wild, so I've been hesitant to teach her how to fully unleash her competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without those restraints, she may win—but it comes at great risk of going wild.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if she were to run wild, there is a possibility that she may never regain control, rendering all her progress pointless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That might be the scariest possible outcome for Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means… we can't go down that road.
choice_data_list: I can't think of one right now, but we'll figure something out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're right. If it were easy to find a perfect technique, everyone would already have one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: All I can do is continue to hone my skills day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may not be able to see the light at the end of the tunnel quite yet, but I know that if she works as hard as she always has, she'll be able to defeat Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All we can do is believe and keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way home, I suddenly realize we haven't decided on our next goal.
choice_data_list: What do you want to do for your next race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest the Takarazuka Kinen, though I know it'll be difficult to run another race so soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking her goal of defeating great opponents and getting the attention of the fans into consideration, the Grand Prix may be a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm. You're right. A Grand Prix would be a great opportunity for me, considering the number of strong opponents they draw. By all means, I'd like to compete.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I wonder who else will be there…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo… City… Oh, it looks like Inari is running as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One—a racer who enjoyed a spectacular run in Oi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She showed everyone her potential for national races at the spring Tenno Sho, and it seems she's already gaining great acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The appearance of a new talent is always cause for celebration in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yet… It also reminds us of the march of time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I'm racing so that the past will not be forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will bring the past back to life at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's cry resounds in the crimson evening sky. But in this sharp, still air, I can't tell whose spirit is roused, hers, or my own.
